André Jean René Lacrampe was a French prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. Born on December 17, 1941, in Agos-Vidalos, France, he was ordained as a priest on May 16, 1970. Lacrampe made significant contributions to the Catholic Church through various roles. 

One of his notable positions was as the Bishop of Ajaccio, where he served from 1995 to 2003. Following this, he became the Archbishop of Besançon, holding the position from 2003 until his retirement in 2013. His tenure in these roles was marked by active involvement in church and community matters, overseeing diocesan activities, and guiding the spiritual life of his congregants.

André Jean René Lacrampe passed away on May 15, 2015. Throughout his ecclesiastical career, he was recognized for his dedication to the Church and his commitment to serving his community.
